policies_sports_schools.qual:
((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM profiles p
  WHERE ((p.id = auth.uid()) AND (p.role = ANY (ARRAY['secretary'::account_role, 'director'::account_role, 'coordinator'::account_role, 'developer'::account_role, 'education_supervisor'::account_role]))))) OR bfr_is_education_supervisor())
